## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass locally or the reason they could not be run is documented.
- [ ] New behavior has regression tests where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and README claims match the implementation.
- [ ] No personal data, secrets, or private resumes are included.

## ML / data changes (if applicable)

- [ ] Data provenance and usage permissions are documented.
- [ ] Evaluation split avoids candidate leakage.
- [ ] Baseline, metrics, and failure analysis are included.
- [ ] Fairness and privacy implications are considered.
